subject: Request: exec authorization for timebound dataplane carveout & pilot pricing
messages:
From: Sophie Lambert <sophie@avalonbio.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T14:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot ask: temporary cross-region dataplane access + limited audit window

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency numbers looked promising. We want to run a 6-month pilot of Redwood Private in our research environment, but our infra team needs a brief carveout to allow cross-region dataplane traffic from our EU cluster to Redwood's US host node for replication during the pilot.

Two asks from our side:
- Timebound dataplane carveout: allow outbound egress from EU -> US for 6 months (Apr 30 - Oct 30) for replication only.
- Audit scope: we can accept a limited audit (sample logs and configuration review) performed remotely, once per month during the pilot, with redacted PII.

We realize this diverges from standard residency guarantees — we would be willing to commit to a 6-month paid pilot (estimated $80k) and are asking for a 20% pilot discount and a waiver of the standard continuous audit access.

I've looped in our legal contact (legal@avalonbio.com) to help with an NDA/addendum. Can your team advise on internal approval steps?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Sophie
Avalon Bio

--

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-04-16T09:03:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Pilot ask: temporary cross-region dataplane access + limited audit window

Team — forwarding Avalon Bio's ask. TL;DR: 6-month pilot, need a temporary dataplane egress carveout (EU->US) for replication only, plus limited (monthly) audit sampling. They propose a 20% pilot discount for the timeboxed commitment. Deal: D-98234.

Suggested next steps:
1) Legal: review the proposed limited audit language and recommend a one-paragraph addendum we can sign that limits scope and redaction requirements. (Laura)
2) Sales/Deal Desk: ok to offer a 20% pilot discount on a month-to-month pilot with an explicit end date? If yes, I can propose a MAT and MOU. (Kim)
3) Exec signoff: this is a non-standard residency carveout + pricing concession; we need an exec authorization for the deviation and to confirm we accept the data residency/timebound exception. (Marcus)

Attachments: pilot_mou_v1.docx (draft MOU) and audit_scope_template.pdf (for legal to tailor).

Notes: Avalon is a mid-size biotech with strong long-term potential; this pilot could convert to Dedicated or Private if performance/ops look good. I recommend we keep the carveout strictly timebound and observable (VPN/flow logs shared to Redwood) and include an automatic rollback clause at pilot end.

Jonas
Sr. Account Exec — Redwood Inference

Thanks for the context, Jonas. I support doing a constrained pilot — high upside if Avalon converts. My recommendations for deal desk/exec approval:

- Pricing: approve a 20% concession applied to the pilot invoices only (6 months max). No permanent list-price change.
- Carveout guardrails:
  * Timebound window: Apr 30 - Oct 30 (hard end date).
  * Purpose-limited: egress allowed for replication traffic only (explicit ports/protocols to be listed).
  * Logging: Avalon must provide weekly flow logs to Redwood; Redwood retains the right to terminate the pilot immediately on anomalous traffic.
- Audit: accept monthly, remote, sampled log review with PII redaction — scope to be finalized by legal.
- Credits/indemnity: no credits for compliance failures; if Avalon requires additional host-level access we push back.

If legal can craft the addendum around the limited audit and rollback clause, I can take this to Deal Desk for formal recommendation to Marcus for exec signoff.

Kim
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: audit_scope_template.pdf (pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T16:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot ask: temporary cross-region dataplane access + limited audit window — legal redlines

Jonas / Kim — reviewed the draft and the audit template. I can do a narrow addendum that: 1) timeboxes the carveout; 2) restricts allowed protocols/IPs; 3) permits monthly, remote sampled log review with explicit redaction obligations for Avalon; and 4) includes an automatic rollback clause at the end date.

Two legal concerns that require exec confirmation:
- We are deviating from our standard "data residency guaranteed" language. Approving this carveout sets a precedent; we should confirm the senior revenue owner's approval for the exception and that we annotate the account record in HubSpot (D-98234) as having a residency carveout.
- The audit scope: we must avoid open-ended host access. The addendum will explicitly prohibit host-level forensic access unless there is a verified security incident — if Avalon insists on broader access, we should require a specific indemnity and additional commercial compensation.

I've prepared a one-page addendum draft (attached) and highlighted the exact clause that needs Marcus' signoff. If Marcus approves, I'll finalize with Avalon legal and sign.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel — Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-04-20T10:21:00Z
Subject: Executive approval request: Avalon Bio pilot carveout & 20% pilot discount (D-98234)

Marcus — quick ask for your approval. Context in bullets:
- Account: Avalon Bio (mid-size biotech)
- Ask: timebound dataplane egress carveout (EU->US) for replication during a 6-month pilot (Apr 30 — Oct 30) + monthly sampled remote audit (PII redacted)
- Commercial: 6-month pilot, month-to-month billing, proposed 20% pilot discount applied to invoices during pilot only. No change to list price after pilot.
- Safeguards: limited protocol/IP list, weekly flow logs to Redwood, automatic rollback at end date, immediate termination on anomalous traffic. Legal has prepared a one-page addendum limiting audit scope and forbidding host-level access unless a verified incident occurs.
- Upside: pilot has a high probability of converting to a Dedicated deployment (estimated ARR > $600k if successful).

Request: Please confirm one of the following texts so we can finalize with customer and sign the addendum:
A) Approved: Redwood exec authorizes the timebound dataplane carveout and 20% pilot discount under the safeguards described above.
B) Denied: Redwood will not approve cross-region egress for Avalon; propose alternate plan.
C) Conditional: Approve only with additional commercial compensation (specify).

Thanks — I can finalize and send the MOU to Avalon as soon as you reply.

Jonas
Sr. Account Exec — Redwood Inference
